mapper.select: INSERT INTO tb_sales_order_hd ( tenant_id, order_no, order_dt, customer_id, quot_no, delivery_dt, delivery_place, delivery_method, status, total_amt, remark, created_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{orderNo}, #{orderDt}, #{customerId}, #{quotNo}, #{deliveryDt}, #{deliveryPlace}, #{deliveryMethod}, #{status}, #{totalAmt}, #{remark}, #{createdBy} ) RETURNING sales_order_id

INSERT INTO tb_sales_order_dt ( sales_order_id, tenant_id, line_no, material_id, order_qty, unit_price, supply_amt, vat_amt, total_amt, delivery_dt, shipped_qty, line_status ) VALUES ( #{salesOrderId}, #{tenantId}, #{lineNo}, #{materialId}, #{orderQty}, #{unitPrice}, #{supplyAmt}, #{vatAmt}, #{totalAmt}, #{deliveryDt}, #{shippedQty}, #{lineStatus} ) RETURNING sales_order_detail_id
